www-7891591.name: Outlaws of the West (Canceled)
www-7891591.author: Dede_
www-7891591.description: This game was supposed to be my biggest project on all my 7 years of KoGaMa. I spent 6 months doing everything there, but due to the current situation of KoGaMa, I decided to cancel it. I thought a lot and concluded that wouldn't worth it to make a very detailed and fun game when, on the other hand, the game (kogama) is very bad optimized (when talking about models) and its losing many players. With that being said, about only 20% of the players would be able to enojoy the gameplay. This game was supposed to have many features besides its main pourpose (sheriffs vs. outlaws). The players would be able to interact with NPCs, do many secundary missions, hunt, sell, buy, loan, rent, kill, defend, upgrade, explore and many other things. Started at: January 14, 2020 Canceled at: July 15, 2020
